facts.big: When is… due? · Here is a gift for…
facts.label: Chá de bebê
facts.sub: Diga Congratulations! Pergunte When is the baby due? e Do you know the name? Entregue Here is a gift for the baby. Peça May I open it now? e pergunte Is the baby room ready?

facts.label: Chá de bebê
facts.sub: O chá de bebê reúne amigas e família antes do nascimento. É uma festa alegre, com presentes, doces e jogos simples para a futura mamãe.

facts.label: Presentes pequenos
facts.sub: Meias, cobertores, brinquedos e roupinhas são presentes comuns. A futura mamãe abre cada um na frente de todos e agradece com carinho.

pages.title: Yellow balloons · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday afternoon in a sunny house in Nashville. Yellow and white balloons float over a long table. Lia walks in with a small box tied with a ribbon. Women laugh, eat cupcakes and drink lemonade. Her friend Dee sits in a big chair. She smiles and puts a hand on her belly.
“Lia! Thank you for coming to my baby shower.” says Dee. “Congratulations! When is the baby due?” says Lia. “The baby is due in October.” says Dee.
